s6.i1: JungleVPN offers servers in various countries around the world to give our users the best possible speed and connectivity. While we aim to select jurisdictions with strong privacy protections, some of our servers may be located in countries with a lower level of democracy according to widely recognized international standards and indices.
s6.i2: When you connect to servers in these locations, JungleVPN will display a warning to inform you of the potential risks. JungleVPN does not recommend using these servers if you are concerned about possible government interference or surveillance.
s6.i3: To minimize risk, we recommend connecting to servers in countries with strong democratic institutions and robust privacy laws. JungleVPN does not work directly with governments in low-democracy countries and does not transfer any user data to them. However, JungleVPN is not responsible for any actions taken by local governments in such countries.
s6.i4: Please take this information into account when choosing a server location. If you have questions or concerns about privacy in a specific location, contact our support team for advice.

what.title: What Is a VPN?
what.subtitle: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) creates a secure, encrypted connection between your device and the internet — so no one can see what you're doing online.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: Your data is scrambled into unreadable code before it leaves your device, so hackers and ISPs can't intercept it.

masking.title: IP Masking
masking.description: Your real IP address is hidden and replaced with the VPN server's address — websites only see the server, not you.

tunnel.title: Secure Tunnel
tunnel.description: All your traffic travels through a private encrypted tunnel between your device and the VPN server, shielded from prying eyes.

why.title: Why You Need a VPN
why.subtitle: Whether you're at home, travelling, or on public Wi-Fi, a VPN keeps your connection private and your data safe.

blocked.title: Access Any Website
blocked.description: Bypass geo-restrictions and censorship. Stream, browse, and use any service from anywhere in the world.

wifi.title: Stay Safe on Public Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Coffee shops and airports are hunting grounds for hackers. A VPN encrypts your traffic so they get nothing useful.

privacy.title: Keep Your Activity Private
privacy.description: Your internet provider can see everything you do. A VPN hides your browsing so your data stays yours alone.
